none: PAS CAM-10D193: Roman Coin : Silver Denarius of Marcus Aurelius and Lucius Verus in Honour of Divus Antoninus Pius, AD138-192
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A silver denarius of Marcus Aurelius and Lucius Verus in honour of Divus Antoninus Pius, AD138-192 (Reece period 8). Reverse legend reads DIVO PIO. Reverse shows altar-enclosure, with double panelled door and horns visible above. See Sear, D.R. Roman Coins and their values: Vol.II. 2002 p.335, no.5196. See RIC 441. Obverse legend reads DIVVS/ANTONINVS. Obverse shows bare head right. Die axis is 6…
